description: Revoke an invite code so nobody else can sign up with it. People who already used it stay linked to their row and keep their access; to cut one of them off use unlink_app_user. Cannot be undone, create a new invite instead. Requires organization owner or admin. Get the invite id (not the code) from list_app_invites.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

inviteId.description: Invite id, the id field from list_app_invites (a UUID, not the code)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: revoke_app_invite
